articles.summary: Two pioneer families created an Anglo-American alliance and pooled resources in order to fund a yeast-powered drug repurposing project for DHDDS deficiency, an ultra-rare inherited metabolic disease.
articles.title: DHDDS Cure Odyssey

articles.summary: Dr Clement Chow's lab ran a fly-powered drug repurposing screen for MAN1B1-CDG. NSAIDs were the top hits. Three pioneer families self-organized an off-label observational study of ibuprofen aka Advil.
articles.title: N-of-3 study of ibuprofen for MAN1B1-CDG
